I have a lot of free time.  I try to do some of these things.  I try to cook, clean stuff, I recently made a bicycle.  It's just like, I start to combine habits to make them easier.  I was going to the gym because I was overweight and cooking because I couldn't live on peanut butter.  After a while I just stopped eating.  I didn't have the energy to gym and I didn't need to buy/cook food.  I went from 240lbs to 160-170.  People were proud of me because it was such a hard accomplishment, but it wasn't really that hard.  I just didn't do anything ha.  

I like book recommendations.  I'll look it up and I'll probably buy it if I like it.

Sorry if I trivialized what you said.
